svg.title: ContextSpeak overall conceptual diagram
svg.desc: Five stages: capture useful English, model learner skills, plan relevant tasks, practice listening and speaking, and update progress. An evaluation band measures unseen comprehension, independent speech, delayed recall, and assessment quality. This is a proposed design with no reported results.
svg.text: Everyday English → personal learning tasks → confident listening and speaking
Delayed, unseen tasks • independent human review • pilot measures, not reported results
Practice evidence → learner model → better task selection → later transfer checks
The database stores learning history; AI generates and assesses within defined rules.
